messages:
Alice Tran: Heads-up — planning kernel-quant-3 rollout tonight during the 23:00-02:00 UTC change window. Plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> full. Need explicit thermal fallback and pin TTLs.

Ben Kaur: 👍 can we default fallback to matmul-v1-quantized and pin the runtime for the canary group? avoids double-flapping.

Carlos Mendez: FYI perf telemetry from last sim shows thermal spikes on older A100s at seq>2048. If we hit thermal alarms we'll want to steer to lower-heat pools or fall back. Suggest enabling thermal-tier-aware routing for the canary.

Sasha Iqbal: I'll update the release notes draft (link: https://go/release-notes/kernel-quant-3) — include: canary schedule, rollback criteria, pin TTLs, operator checklist.

Tony Nguyen: Adding quick checklist here: smoke + traces, p50/p99 perf, error-rate, memory regressions, thermal probe, package checksum. If any check fails -> hold and escalate.

deploybot: Preflight started for job kernel-quant-3 (triggered by @Alice Tran)
- packaging: ok
- checksum: ok
- staging-smoke: ok
- perf-diff (canary image vs baseline): p50 +3ms, p90 +12ms, p99 +25ms (within thresholds)
- thermal-probe: synthetic load shows +12C on older A100 subset (expected margin)
- artifacts: signed

deploybot: Preflight result: PASSED (with thermal advisory). fallback advised: matmul-v1.

Alice Tran: Good, thanks. Proceed with scheduled canary at 23:15 UTC. Keep canary slice at 5% for 20m hold.

Ben Kaur: Proposal for pin TTLs: canary=30m, regional-rollout=2h. If we pin shorter we risk churning; if too long we delay fixes.

Sasha Iqbal: Rollback criteria (to include in notes):
- p99 latency increase > 40ms sustained for 5m OR
- request error-rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m OR
- memory growth rate > 10% over baseline in 10m
If any trigger flips, immediate rollback to previous engine and open incident.

Carlos Mendez: Ops runbook quick action:
1) If thermal alarms > 8% of serving fleet, enact fallback to matmul-v1 in the affected region.
2) Notify infra on-call and add thermal tags to incident.
3) Re-run perf sim on a hot-node subset after revert.

Tony Nguyen: Adding config snippet for the deploy command — copy/paste safe:
```
/deploy start \\n  --job kernel-quant-3 \\n  --canary 5% \\n  --hold 20m \\n  --fallback matmul-v1 \\n  --pin-ttl 1800
```

Ben Kaur: I'll watch telemetry and be ready to pin/unpin groups. If we see early flake, I'll pin the engine on the canary slice and open a rollback ticket.

ops-bot: Scheduled canary job kernel-quant-3 for 1768125200 (23:15 UTC). Reminder: change window 23:00-02:00 UTC.

Alice Tran: Perfect. Sasha — ping me when notes updated and I'll post the announce in #release-notes.

Sasha Iqbal: Will do. Adding the rollback criteria and the thermal fallback steps now.

Tony Nguyen: Quick note for postmortem: capture node temperature histogram + request spatial distribution if we hit fallback.

Carlos Mendez: Also record the quantization kernel version and kernel ABI used in the canary metadata (helps debug subtle FP edgecases).

Alice Tran: Thanks everyone. I'll stand by at deploy time in case we need to fast-revert. :thumbsup:
